## What to build

Publish wallet-to-wallet transfer events from payment-platform whenever a successful transfer is committed.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Event is published on every successful transfer.
- [ ] Event payload includes sender, recipient, amount, currency, and transfer id.
- [ ] Unit tests cover the publisher.
